# example/syn/noop — the runtime stages' fixture

The compile-verified reference skeleton (tools/sparq-module-guest/examples/noop-instrument),
componentised and sha-pinned by `tests/instrument_runtime.rs`. Silence in the exact negotiated
shapes, an empty at-rest display, refusals in words. It exists so the hand-in gate's runtime
stages have a package to prove themselves against — a gate that has never failed anything has
never gated anything.
